scope: Theorem 1.2 (Completion under quasi-Albanese exactness) of the manuscript “Two-step monodromy of special quasi-projective varieties” (preprints/Two-step-monodromy-of-special-quasi-projective-varieties-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 057 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbc966a951e13d2e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be a connected smooth complex quasi-projective variety and let a : V → A = Alb(V ) be its algebraic quasi-Albanese map. Suppose a is dominant, choose a smooth connected general fibre F and a point v ∈ F, and assume that the sequence of ordinary fundamental groups π1(F, v) −→ Γ := π1(V, v) a∗ − → Λ := π1(A, a(v)) −→ 1 (1.1) is exact. Then every canonical rational unipotent quotient of Γ has nilpotency class at most two. The full rational unipotent completion is a finite-dimensional unipotent algebraic group of class at most two. Every finite-dimensional complex unipotent representation of Γ also has image of class at most two.
